reason: I forget my vitamins at home all the time and I live out of a gym bag, so a sachet I can toss in a pocket actually fits how I live. At $24 after the launch discount I would try one box, but only because of the sachet.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. Full price for one month of magnesium feels like a lot, so I would not reorder unless I clearly notice it helps.
would_change_my_mind: A full-price box at $24 or under, or a bigger box (like 60 sachets) at about the same cost per day.
